scope:
Supplement existing paired reports with a reference-search-phase view.

Compare each native COMPLETE workflow with its pair's recorded original SEARCH
phase, excluding original database construction. No new measurements are run.
This favors the reference: native still pays parsing/encoding/database creation,
while original uses the database just created by its omitted build phase. It is
not an independently measured prebuilt-database or engine-only benchmark.

method.numerator: native complete workflow wall_seconds, including in-memory DB creation/output
method.denominator: reference.search.wall_seconds, excluding preceding original DB build phase
method.suite_metric: ratio of sums of six case arithmetic means, not average ratios
method.bootstrap: independently resample complete paired repetition indexes per case; joint percentile95% suite interval; pointwise case intervals
method.trial_exclusion: predeclared warmups only; all measured pairs/outliers retained
method.timing_scope: post-hoc view of the existing experiment, not new engine-only or prebuilt-DB measurement

common_identity.cache_policy: warm-cache workflow measurements; no filesystem/page-cache eviction or flushing
common_identity.timing_boundary: workflow wall: immediately before build/native subprocess through complete search/native captured stdout+stderr; excludes temporary directory creation/deletion, pin verification, parity checks and reporting
common_identity.workflow_difference: reference uses two processes and fresh on-disk v5 storage; native uses one process and in-memory storage
common_identity.output_policy: both sides capture all 19 fields into Python memory on every run; compare outside timed intervals
common_identity.precision: exact ordered non-floating fields; compare_search.py BLAST CLI precision rules for Evalue/bit score

record.scope: end-to-end FASTA-to-captured-results user workflow; not engine-only speed
record.interpretation: Results apply only to the supplied inputs, artifact, settings and host. No workload representativeness or engine-only speed is inferred from this workflow comparison.
record.workflow_difference: reference uses two processes and fresh on-disk v5 storage; native uses one process and in-memory storage
record.timing_boundary: workflow wall: immediately before build/native subprocess through complete search/native captured stdout+stderr; excludes temporary directory creation/deletion, pin verification, parity checks and reporting
record.cache_policy: warm-cache workflow measurements; no filesystem/page-cache eviction or flushing
record.output_policy: both sides capture all 19 fields into Python memory on every run; compare outside timed intervals
record.precision: exact ordered non-floating fields; compare_search.py BLAST CLI precision rules for Evalue/bit score

translated_source_pin.policy: Immutable reference source. Do not update the release or change reference files implicitly. Translation candidates are not a complete dependency closure.
